paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Vented Hood — Clubsport is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+ and the BMW 2-Series G42 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon hood delivers aggressive CSL-inspired styling while improving airflow and thermal management in the engine bay.

The Clubsport version of Alpha-N's vented hood builds on their standard carbon hood by integrating additional cooling vents positioned on either side of the power dome. These Clubsport-specific side vents (AN-0331 + AN-0332) are always included and increase heat extraction from the engine compartment while emphasising the motorsport character of the G87 M2.
